description: Fina is a Enforcers Daughter, she's been harshly trained by her father all her life. On the night of the change, to which you could find your soul mate- Fina finds hers. He's of course the soon to be Alpha, however he doesn't want her. Its not sweat off Fina's back, she's more worried about her Family finding out then being rejected. Her feet carry her to a deeper part of the forest, one she shouldn't of gone into. When things twist and stories become a reality Fina will have to pick what side she wants to be part of.

Hi, my name is Bella, and I'm just the ordinary teenage girl. Um, WRONG! I'm a mermaid. Yeah, you read it right. A mermaid. I live off the coast of Hawaii where sailors come and go.

Oh, and no, I'm not some creepy siren who drags men out to sea. I'm just a peaceful little mermaid.

Anyways, one day while coming close to the shore, I saw a very attractive young boy surfing. And when a wave took him under and he didn't come up, I swam to him and rescued him.. And I'm pretty sure he saw me before he blacked out. 

Woops.

description:
The five heroes. They all have their story ending but what if their stories continue...together?

They have their lives. Elsa is unhappy. Merida frustrated. Jack is bored. Rapunzel's free. Hiccup is no longer underestimated.

But what if Manny decides to bring them together? 

Will they fall in love? 

Even if some of them are from the past? 

Will the new guardians except their challenge?

Pitch is back. But this time his stronger... along with a few nightmares from the heroes haunting past. 

He knows their secrets...and their feelings for each other.

Will he use it to hes advantage?

Do they have why it takes to accept love and defeat fear?

description:
What if Kaname and Yuki had a younger sister?

What if that sister went from loving them, to hating them?

What if she fell in love with Zero?

What if… everything in her life… fell apart?

What if… she wished to… devour everyone…?

What if darkness nipped at her feet every moment of the day?

What pain will befall Yukiko Kuran, Yui Hakama, and Yanase Kai?


Find out, in the tragic love of this Vampire Knight Fanfiction, 'Awaking'.

''There will be no Zhan Qing Lian anymore as my existence is a threaten to my family . I want to be the one protecting, not a burden.''

An -eight - year old girl chose her life to live as a man not to be woman.

''Our general is the god of war but ... He likes beauties''

The general who is said to be the god of war lost the battle in Qin qiao war. Will he be caught by the enemy or not? Who is the betrayer?

" Go and take a look who is there in the river"
Her body is full of wounds . Let take her to ben wang ye's home
 
Who am I? 

Who is she? 

I don't care who you are. I care only the love between you and me.

What will they choose? Their motherland or love.
Will they able to make the right choice?
Will their love last forever?
As both of them have the desire to protect the country.
What will happen at the end?

sa isang WELSTON UNIVERSITY  ay may 4 na transfer at 4 na badboy ay kung saan magkakalaban ang boys and girls.. kumbaga ang mga boys ang KILALANG KAAWAY ANG MGA GIRLS ..... meron din silang sariling katangiang taglay pero ito at mababangis.

meet Chantelle Kyrzza Quintos , ang pinaka masungit sa kanilang apat , mayaman , matalino ,  mahilig mag suot ng mga pangsexy na damit at higit sa lahat volleyball player.   . Kathleen Marie Ang, matalino ,mabait, weird at mahilig magbasa ng mga libro. Ayanna Joy Thirllwall , mabait , mahilig sa make up at mga maiigsing damit . Fiona Bianca Ferriol , magaling kumanta at talented sa kanilang apat.


Yuan Mendoza , ang pinaka badboy ng WELSTON UNIVERSITY , matalino , laging nakasimangot , mayaman ,  Pinakakinakatakutan sa buong campus , WALANG PAKELAM SA MUNDO , Player ng basketball , heartthrob , mahilig uminom ng alak , naninigarilyo at higit sa lahat basagulero.



Joaquin Miguel Delos Santos , mahilig mambabae , at katulad din ni yuan , matalino, basketball player at PINAKA WOMANIZER.




Clodd Roel Hernandez ,  laging may pagkain , isip bata magisip , laging nakasalamin na nerd, mayaman , at matalino pero gangster.



Llanz Steven Espinosa ,  laging nakangiti at tumatawa , mejo masungit sa mga babae , mahilig din uminom at makipag away .




what if magkatagpo sila? magiging masaya ba sila sa unang pagpasok nila ng WELSTON UNIVERSITY?

description:
Percy Jackson falls. He falls into the river Lethe. His world tipped over, the sun mourned and the stars fell from Percy's eyes. Gone and gone, washed down the river and no where  found.
Jason's world became Percy Jackson. Percy's stars were Jason's suns and Percy's eyes were his moon and Percy's arms were his earth. Nobody can live without the stars and the sun. The stars swept away by raging water were destined to be found. 

The were destined to find them together.

You are the Daughter of William T. Spears. You are out in the human world, Even though your dad William Forbids it, as you have not been trained to be a grim reaper yet...You still do anyways. A suspicious figure seems to be following you, And soon he grabs you, pulling you into a Dark Alley...You struggle to get free.....Someone saves you.......Its a boy with Midnight blue colored hair, Blue eyes......or eye... and an eyepatch....He seems about your age. He's accompanied with a tall male with Dark black hair and in a tux. As soon as you see the boy you get butterflies in your stomach........What is this feeling? Could it be? No. It can't be love! ......Can it?
Hope you guys like my first Fanfiction!!!!! FYI It has slow updates!

[Edit/Warning: Written during my newbie days, sorry if it's kinda crappy XD ]

Have you watched the Anime, Kamigami no Asobi??

Not yet? Well I advice you to watch it NOW! It's a good Anime *wink* 

Yes...?

If so,

I invite you to read this book of mine! Romantic One-Shots of KNA which includes YOU! Yes! YOU! Have you ever thought what it would be like if it was YOU instead of Yui that they fell inlove with?

DISCLAIMER: I do not own any of the Kamigami no Asobi characters. I also do not own (First Name). They all belong to their rightful owners.

(I still think that I'm an amateur writer. So please bear with my style of writing.)

description:
He's psychotic, mad in the head, and shivers at the sweet taste of flesh. 

All Jeff desired was the perfect kill. A victim to fight back, give him a challenge, and amuse his sick cravings. He found who he was looking for, but was she too feisty, even for his taste? Too accustomed to his being there? When Jeff realizes this, he doesn't know whether to end her or not. The option is tempting, but there's something deeper to this story. Something that prohibits his inner murderer from stabbing her lifeless.

He begins to feel something sick, even sicker than all the blood shed and fear he's caused, the longer he's met with those green, nostalgic eyes.

He begins to remember.

description:
Michiko Tsukiko....what a cute name, isn't it? Well, ...its not. I lived in a simple life, in a simple house, and in a simple school.

Straight A's, yes, Im in class A. I dont know why...why do we need to learn? Doesn't this just add problems to our life? Too much questions.

I live alone, no relatives that I know. I just got a house with no people. Strange, isn't it? Of course it is.

Ehem...Lets go to the real subject. Im Michiko Tsukiko. Secret is my friend. I dont know if Im abandoned or lost. Because right now, Im lost in this maze of life.

○○○○○

Hey, hey! Im Michiko Tsukiko~ Ehe! Is it too creepy if I talk like that? I know right....so I mask it up~!

description:
When her four year old daughter informs her a sick man is in their yard, Honor Gillette rushes out to help him. But that "sick" man turns out to be Lee Coburn, the man accused of murdering seven people the night before. Dangerous, desperate, and armed, he promises Honor that she and her daughter won't be hurt as long as she does everything he asks. She has no choice but to accept him at his word.

But Honor soon discovers that even those close to her can't be trusted. Coburn claims that her beloved late husband possessed something extremely valuable that places Honor and her daughter in grave danger. Coburn is there to retrieve it -- at any cost. From FBI offices in Washington, D.C., to a rundown shrimp boat in coastal Louisiana, Coburn and Honor run for their lives from the very people sworn to protect them, and unravel a web of corruption and depravity that threatens not only them, but the fabric of our society

Who will win?....Who will die or survive?......Will they defeat the enemy or will everything go down in flames before it even starts?.....

description:
Run.  Dont turn back.  Just keep running.  Nothing could happen worse then what happened before.  You didnt do anything to deserve some of the things you were put through, but it didnt seem to matter... Because you lost everything.  You lost your family, your home, and everything you owned.  

Your home had burned down, and the only family who survived had been your mother, who got diagnosed with cancer shortly after.. you had nothing left after your mother left... or atleast, thats what you thought.  You were taken in by a man named Ludwig, who treated you as a sister.  You were loved by all the people you met while staying with Germany, but you specifically caught the eyes of two Italian brothers.

WARNING: Bad Language, Blood, Awesomeness, and a Lemon in later chapters (maybe)

DISCLAIMER:  I do not own Hetalia, nor do I really own you, but I do own this story.

Now his father, threatens him either to get a job or ship out. Literally SHIP OUT. In other words, if he doesnt get a job and make some money his father is going to send him out on the streets.
 Scared and helpless Jeremy goes on a hunt to find a job at any risk. "Luckily" Jeremy finds a job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria, where he meets 20 year old Michael Schmidt, his working partner. They start off at a rough start but slowly the begin to realize that what they have is way more than what they could ever imagine. Unfortunately Mike is datting someone by the name of Doll and is torn between the two, and A boy named vincent hits on Jeremy! will Mike leave his girlfriend to save the realashionship he has with Jeremy or will it all be more complicated than that?

Annie Leonhardt did a bad thing.  
And now she's in prison for it. 

And now she's done another bad thing...

This is the story of the affair between police officer Armin Arlert and inmate Annie Leonhardt. 

Armin was falling in love - but was Annie telling the truth? 

A game is being played, and with time running out, and dangerous people trying to reach her, Annie has big decisions to make. Anything she does from now on will have consequences; and that includes anything related to Armin. 

Will Armin be dragged down Annie's dangerous path? Or will his uncontrollable love for her send him there voluntarily?

description:
Vandaag, een zonnige dag in Augustus, gaat het onmogelijke gebeuren. Ik ga naar een bingoclub. Oersaai. Mijn vriendengroepje en ik doen het voor Sydney. Ze kreeg gisteren een brief. Blijkbaar een speciale brief ofzo. Er stond in dat ze een uitverkorene was. Toen ik dat hoorde zuchtte ik diep. Ze is super aardig, maar ze kan ook echt aparte, saaie trekjes hebben. Ze stond erop dat we mee gingen vandaag, mee naar dé bingo-avond. Nou, iedereen dacht hetzelfde als mij -niet de allerliefste gedachtegang- maar toch is Sydney het gelukt. We gaan naar de bingoclub. 
Niet geweten dat het zo zou aflopen. Niet geweten wat uitverkorene betekende. Niet geweten dat sommigen nooit terug zouden keren...

Nào đó tống nghệ trong tiết mục,

Người chủ trì nói đùa nói Nguyên Mãn cùng Vệ Lạc hai cái đem bọn họ cảm động khóc, muốn thế nào phụ trách?

Nguyên Mãn: "Muốn không có tiền, muốn chết không được, muốn Vệ Lạc có một... "

...

[ tiểu kịch trường ]:

Nguyên Mãn cùng Vệ Lạc tình cảm lưu luyến công khai sau, người ái mộ lão ở nàng Weibo hạ thúc dục nàng: Nằm vùng, giao ra lão đại ảnh chụp! Tha cho ngươi cướp chúng ta nam thần tội ~

description:
A hybrid is a being that is part human and part animal. More often than not, the human part of them outweighs the animal part. But, what happens when something triggers that animal part of them? And forces them to rely on their most basic actions. Forces them to rely on instincts. Their feral instincts.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

“Harry?” Louis asked, his voice wrecked, barley able to speak anything above a whisper. His throat strained to make any noise at all and was so sore. Louis received no word response but was shocked when a low growl began to rumble from Harry’s chest. It would have froze a person in their place had it been anyone there but Louis. Louis’ frown deepened even more, confused at his hybrid’s actions.

“Hazza?”

description:
cinta? 
Apa itu cinta?
Yang aku tau, cinta adalah sebuah penyakit di bagian terdalam organ tubuh kita yang terletak di sebelah jantung.
Sakit, satu kata yang sangat tepat untuk menggambarkan definisi apa itu cinta. Bagi sebagian orang, Cinta itu indah, cinta itu bisa membuat mereka bahagia. Iya itu bagi mereka yang beruntung, bagi mereka yang cintanya terbalas. Jangan kalian fikir cinta itu seperti gulali. Manis di awal sampai akhir. Blur banget kalo Cinta itu seperti itu.
Namaku Aggie, tepatnya Aggie Amanda yang berarti pantas di cintai dan di inginkan, seorang gadis biasa dari kalangan menangah kebawah, salah satu keryawan di perusahaan yang lumayan terkemuka, dan selalu gagal dalam ber Cinta.
Blushit banget kalo Cinta itu indah, iya indah di awal dan di akhir? Jangan Tanya lagi. Lihat saja mereka yang selalu mengumbar kemesraan di sosial media, kita lihat tak lama dari itu mungkin kabar duka ankan terpampang jelas di kolom status sosial media masing masing memenuhi semua bernda sosial media dengan ocehan ocehan galau tak berkelas ala jomblo jaman now.
Dulu aku begitu sangat memuja Cinta, karena Cinta aku bisa bertemu denganya, dia yang sekarang ini ingin sekali aku enyahkan dari fikiranku.
Karena cinta aku bisa mengenalnya, mengenal kepribadianya, mengenal sifatnya dan sangat mengenal bagaimana cara dia begitu lembut mematahkan Cintaku.
Dulu aku selalu memanggilnya, Jodohku. Ya itu dulu beberapa tahun yang lalu, disaat aku masih menduduki bangku kuliah di Universitas yang sama denganya. Di saat Cinta masih begitu Indah untukku hingga tanpa sadar aku sudah terlalu dalam tenggalam di lautan penuh kesakitan, Pesanku untuk Cinta. LUPAKAN atau PERGI

Imagine that Lucky is taller than AC

Meet Andree Camille Bonifacio a.k.a Ac. She is great at dancing and she have a bestfriend which is a boy named Reyond Lucky Ancheta or Lucky for short.
AC is kind,smart,talented,beautiful. To make it short, she is almost perfect.

Meet Reyond Lucky Ancheta or Lucky for short. He is also great at dancing that's why him and AC are partners at dancing.
He is kind,handsome,talented and smart like AC.

They both promise to each other that they will never leave each other and not to hide any secrets from each other.

But if one day,both of them realized that they love each other?

Will they hide it from each other or tell it to one another?

Will they still remain their friendship or forget about each other?

Find out if they still remain
 their friendship.

[ EDITED PROLOGUE ]

What happens when our favorite annoying, blonde, music loving, 18 year old Guillotine weapon meets someone worse than his Arch enemy, Giriko? Especially when it's Giriko's sister?

A whole lot of romantic, humorous and thrilling adventures, that's what!

But When did Giriko have a sister? How the hell did Justin suddenly end up being partnered up with HER? What was this spark that the both of them always felt whenever they would connect their wave lengths? And what's this?! A new enemy has emerged from the shadows and was ready to take HER revenge. But, what was she after?

Justin's adventure was yet to begin, with new character's appearing and plot twists jumping out of nowhere, there's no telling what happens in this story. But what you're going to expect is that there's going to be lots of love with both the main and side characters!

This was Justin's biggest fight yet... was it HIS fight in the first place? Or was there something else worth fighting for?

"Papa?" The little girl looked up at the man who stood before her.

"Yes?"

Sarada grabbed his only hand.

"Can you promise me that no matter what, you will never forget me when you're traveling."

"Of course.... And besides, I could never forget my little girl, traveling or not."
_________________________

Sasuke Uchiha was very protective of his daughter. His one and only child. He would often play with Sarada, but only Sakura witnessed it. 

Sasuke will always watch over his princess, even when traveling to fix what he did wrong.

[SasuSara]

description:
(Y/n) (l/n) has just transferred to Crimson Scarlet's Academy For The Gifted. It is a legendary school that has taught some of the world's most brilliant people. when (y/n) arrives, she can already tell something is off.
She goes into her classroom, but nobody is there yet. She continues to wait, but no one shows up. (y/n) decided to investigate. she searches the entire school but no one is around. She begin to panic when she hears a scream and a loud crash. When (y/n) follows the sounds, she finds herself in the school kitchen. After she sees nothing and begins to walk away, there is a bunch of rapid knocks and the same scream coming from the freezer, (y/n) rushes to the freezer and unlocks it. 
There runs out a boy covered in ice and freezing to death. His name is Oliver. 
(y/n) and Oliver decide to investigate the disappearance of the schools students and staff. Will they uncover the mystery or unravel a dark secret that the school is harboring?

description:
Marie Wilson never thought that she'd be a lesbian when she got older, when she was in the fourth grade, and had just found out qhat homosexuality really was, she ewwed and was disgusted at the idea of it, even though she'd looked at many beautiful women with an appreciative eye from time to time, but two years later, in sixth grade, she grew a crush on one of her best friends, which lead her to become very homophobic in the seventh grade, but in the next year, she gave up, and decided she couldn't fight her attraction towards other females any longer, she'd thought this meant she was bisexual, but towards the end of that year, she discovered she had no attractions to boys whatsoever, and started to date girls more frequently. She is now in her freshman year, she's already had four different girlfriends before, but this one, Beatrice, she was head over heels for, she knew she'd had a past of unfaithfulness, but that was all in the past, she was good now, right?
      Destiny Stewarts has been openly lesbian ever since the fifth grade, at first she'd assumed it was a phase, as her mother had called it, but after six years of only longing for females, she was past thoughts like that, now a junior in highschool, she really liked to go out and party! She was a stickler for a faithful relationship, but when she was single, she'd find a one night stand, being sure to use the proper protection, however when she finds out that one of her "one time only" playmates has a girlfriend, she is enraged, and decides not only that she is going to take her vengence upon her, but also to pour salt on the wound, she would make whoever this girlfrined was, her's! 
        What is to become of the thee?

I dont know but I know you want to...

description:
Una palabra es: un sonido solo eso igual que el molesto ruido de mosquito en tu oído, es un sonido al que le damos significado e importancia.
Unos nacen sin poder decir una jamás, otros nunca escuchan ni a ese molesto insecto y algunos más que tienen todo, pero no lo expresan, ese es mi caso.
Siendo la hija menor de una problemática familia con un padre que uso tal sonido en tu contra, no me quedo más opción que aprender a ignorar no solo las palabras si no a todo, algo que me protegió durante años pero a la vez también me aisló, un lado negativo de esta decisión, uno que no note hasta que un desconocido entro en mi vida tan repentino como el rayo sobre un árbol y tan necesario como el respirar, llego para mostrarme lo que yo misma ignoraba mi deseo de compañía y en especial para enseñarme lo importante de la comunicación, simplemente me mostro mi propia necesidad de hablar.

Cảnh báo : Truyện đôi lúc sẽ có cảnh bạo lực, máu me và rất ngược, ai không hài lòng có thể  click back.

Summary :

~ oOo ~

"Đồng thoại - những bức tranh mà trí tưởng tượng đã vẽ ra cho trẻ con. Lũ trẻ thích truyện cổ tích, chúng yêu những cái kết có hậu và những con người xinh đẹp. Chúng yêu những chuyện tình ngọt ngào và lãng mạn. Những kẻ xấu chỉ là cái nền để công chúa và hoàng tử đạp lên để có thể tỏa sáng."

Đồng thoại - trong veo như ly nước và ngây thơ như đóa huệ tây.  Nhưng câu chuyên đồng thoại tôi sắp kể cho các bạn là một câu chuyện đồng thoại rất khác.

...

Gã khao khát được cảm nhận hơi ấm của tình yêu ...

Thứ mà bao lâu nay gã chưa một lần với tới.

Cần lắm một cái ôm ấp áp ,

Cần lắm một ánh nhìn yêu thương ,

Cần lắm gia đình mà hắn đã phá nát nhiều năm trước ....

           *      *      *

Giữa dòng người vô cảm, chỉ có mình em trao cho tôi cái nhìn yêu thương ...

Điều gì đã khiến em chú ý đến một tên khốn như tôi ?

Gã tuyệt vọng nhìn khuôn mặt xấu xí của mình trong gương ...

Gã không thể yêu cô ấy , và cũng không dám yêu .

           *      *      *

description:
Maraming bagay ang aking ipinagtataka sa ating munting mundong puno ng misteryo.

Isa na rito ang "tayo", na dati'y panghalip lamang na pinagaaralan sa paaralan, na ngayo'y naging "Ikaw at ako, sorry walang tayo." 

Isusunod ko na ang "gusto". Oo, gusto mo nito, gusto mo iyan, pero gusto ka rin ba niya? Ang isang bagay na walang kaalam-alam, walang kaimik-imik, ay nasasali sa iyong tila panaginip na mawawala lamang sa iyong pagising na 'love life'. 

Maraming bagay at maraming pagkakataon ang ating matutuklasan sa bawat patak ng oras at bawat patak ng segundo na ating nasasayang sa ating hindi makabuluhang pagaasam ng isang di makatotohanang buhay. 

Ito ang aking mga sulat para sa iyo.

Samantha had the looks every girl envied and was the one every guy wanted to date. But when an accident tears her family apart and her supposed friends turn on her, Samantha goes into hiding.. literally.
Starting at a new school, with new friends, Sam assembles an outfit that will hopefully attract the right attention. All is going smoothly when the popular, arrogant, self- centered, egotistical, cold hearted, player aka Jarrah Kiln unravels all of Samantha's secrets. What will happen now that she's no longer able to hide behind her disguise. Well if Sam has anything to do with it, he'll be trying to crawl back under the rock he come from because he is messing with the wrong beauty in disguise.

description:
"I hate you."

"You can't get enough of me."

Shayna Lane and her friends all wanted to venture out on their own, buying their own houses and finally being free, but everyone had decided to keep close and live in groups of two.

Of course, her roommate was Adrian.

Adrian Sorensen. He's known Shay since high school, and has always liked her. He hooked up with every girl he met and always loved Shayna for her physical appearance. 
But these last months, Adrian has become more of a gentlemen. He stopped loving Shayna for her looks and started to enjoy her personality. He didn't focus on other girls; just Shayna.

Shayna and Adrian have been friends for a while, introduced to each other by another girl in the group.

At first, Shayna hated Adrian. He was loud, annoying and wouldn't leave her alone.
But now, he's... kind.


What's he doing to her?!

Si Azzeletia Bree Loyola isang Dalaga na grabe kung magmahal at grabe rin Masaktan.


Nakipaghiwalay sakanya ang kaniyang pinakamamahal na si Alessandro Dope Sy, sa kadahilang May sakit ito pero hindi ipinaalam sa dalaga.


Simula noong iniwan ni Dope si Azzeletia naging malungkot na ang mundo ng dalaga, Hanggang sa naisip ng mga kaibigan nito na ipakilala sa kanya si John Aurum Martin Lazaro o Jam.


Hanggang sa nahulog si Azzeletia kay Jam subalit Dumating ulit si Dope para kuhain ang dalaga.


Sino ang pipiliin ng dalaga?
Si Dope na Handa siyang Mahalin muli?
O Si Jam na kaya siyang Ipaglaban hanggang sa huli?

I felt an slight breeze.
Nasaan ba ako?
Patay na ba ako?
Sinusubukan kong tumayo pero hindi ko magawa.
Kahit mata ko hindi ko maimulat.
Ayoko munang tingnan kung nasaan na ako.
Natatakot akong malaman na patay na ako.
"We've been waiting you for so long years."
"Come in the world where you belong."
Wait lang sinusundo nya na ba ako?
Bumulong sya pero hindi ko narinig.
A portal came through the walls.

description:
Aries Motenire,a 23 years old lady.Maganda at  mayaman.Panganay sa apat na magkakapatid.Pareho silang mga dependent ng mga kapatid niya.They chose to live dependently than to live like a princess.Ayaw nilang umasa sa mga magulang nila.
"Dapat matuto tayong buhayin ang sarili natin.H'wag yung iaasa natin lahat kay Mom at Dad lahat ng needs natin"
Iyan ang mga katagang palaging sinasabi ni Aries sa mga nakababatang kapatid niya.Bagama't pasaway ang bunso nilang si Izra,pilit pa rin nila itong iniintindi sa kadahilanang college student lamang ito.
Nagtatrabaho si Aries sa isang malaking kompanya as a secretary.Para sa kanya,mahirap ang kanyang trabaho sapagkat maraming utos ang nakaatang sa kanya.Encode here and there,appointment here and there,at ang mga tambak na papeles na pinapagawa ng boss niyang walang ibang ginawa kundi ang landiin ang mga empleyado niya.Si Stephen Kim.Ang boss niya.Hindi niya alam kung bakit hindi niya magawang umalis sa kompanyang pinagtatrabahuhan niya.Malaki rin naman ang kanyang sweldo ngunit halos siya na ang gumagawa ng mga bagay na dapat si Sir Stephen ang gumagawa.
"This is my job,so,I have to do this" palaging sinasabi ni Aries sa kapatid niyang si Jen.Ang pangalawa sa apat.Tanging si Jen lang ang nakakaintindi sa mga desisyon niya.Kaya kahit na nahihirapan siya sa trabaho niya tinatanggap niya pa rin ito.

BUT

Isang araw,nagising na lamang siya sa tabi ng boss niya.

Hindi niya alam ang nangyari .


Ano kaya ang mga mangyayari pagkatapos ng nangyari sa kanila ng boss niya?Yun ay kung may nangyari nga ba.

Feel free to ask me questions, I'll put the answers in this book and tag you :)

Do NOT ask me anything related to the following topics, please:

- Address 
- Phone #
- Nudes or any sexual content 
- School info (You can ask about pep rallies and what school events and such happen or whatever)
- Pretty much just don't ask anything too personal.

I might also ask you guys suggestions on book ideas or drawing ideas. Also, I may host contests or something like that as well in this book.

description:
September Gray, editor of both her school's newspaper and literary magazine, just wants to make it through her sophomore year and get out into the real world. Captivated in a penitentiary known as high school she finds it easier to be an introvert and hide behind music and words. 

On her 16th birthday, she goes from being behind the scenes to the subject of the front page story. Not sure how to deal with everything she starts a blog with a pseudonym called "Nicole in the Middle".  Her alter ego is her only sense of control now, and that is threatened when September's blog raises in popularity. Everyone wants to know who Nicole is. And according to doctors, her time is running out. 

Reader beware, for the plot twists will make you pull out your hair. A contemporary suspense story with a dash of fan fiction and a twist of lime.

"Your outfit is worth more than my whole apartment, or my existence. " Amberleigh retorted sourly, as Gavin troted around the room Touching. Absolutely. Everything.
"Thats the thing about having money," he replied, oblivious to the poison in her voice, " you get to spend it." he touched a picture of her and her sister from a year ago. A very, very, long time ago it seemed.
"Just, sit down. You make me nervous doing that." She itched for him to sit still and shut up for two seconds. He didn't. Gavin decided to make his way to the back of the apartment.
"Gavin! That is off limits, no!" Amberleigh shrieked in fright. Her room was a disaster zone and clothes were everywhere.

description:
She's the campus of our school. Mula noong high school pa lang, wala ng umagaw sa title nya. She's not the ordinary Campus Queen na maarte at pinapatos ang kahit sino.

She helps every students sa school namin. Natulong sya sa SSG at YES-O. Volleyball player sya at MVP sya sa larangang yun.  Kaya hindi na nakakapagtaka kung bakit madaming may gusto sa kanya at madami din syang kaibigan. 


Alam ng lahat ng tungkol sa kanya maliban sa pagiging asawa ko.

Hindi naman sa kinahihiya ko sya o kinahihiya nya ako. I am the son of the owner of this school. And I dont have a choice kung bakit ako ang nag sisimula ng istoryang to. 

I dont love her but she's my bestfriend. We promise na walang magkakagusto sa amin dahil may mahal akong iba. 

At ngayong patapos na kami ng college, pipilitin namin na walang makaalam ng tinatago namin. She is my wife. The Campus Queen is my wife.
